# CreativzEdge Studio

> Graphic design studio based in Chennai and Mumbai, India, offering brand
> identity, packaging, print, social media creative, and digital growth
> (SEO/GEO/AEO/SMO) services. 15+ years of design experience, 1000+ projects
> delivered, clients across India, UK, and USA.

CreativzEdge is a creative design studio led by an Arena Multimedia certified
specialist. We design logos, brand identity systems, packaging, social media
creatives, print collateral, event branding, and vehicle branding, and pair
that with SEO/GEO/AEO growth services to make brands discoverable both in
traditional search and in AI answer engines.

## Services
- [Logo & Brand Identity](https://PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/services): primary/secondary logos, color palette, typography systems, brand guidelines
- [Packaging Design](https://PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/services): box/carton dielines, label & sticker design, 3D mockups
- [Social Media Creatives](https://PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/services): Instagram/Facebook posts, reel covers, LinkedIn/Twitter banners
- [Print & Advertising](https://PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/services): brochures, catalogues, posters, banners, business cards, menus
- [Digital Growth](https://PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/services): SEO, GEO, AEO, social media optimization
